results.rationale:
The project satisfies `requirements.integration.live_bedrock_test`.

- `tests/live_bedrock.rs#fn[live_bedrock_authoring]` implements the live integration test itself. It skips immediately when `CI` is set, before calling `selected_config()` or any credential logic. It then selects a Bedrock configuration, creates a temporary fixture project, runs `author-evidence` with `--stdout`, asserts success, verifies the returned evidence JSON, confirms the fixture source was read, and checks that no checkout evidence directory was created. They honor `HABEAS_LIVE_CONFIG`, otherwise use the same authoring precedence as the checkout, and fall back to the first Bedrock configuration in name order among user and workspace configs. Invalid explicit selections and malformed configuration are both handled as test failures.
- `tests/live_bedrock.rs#fn[credentials_available]` uses the AWS SDK to load credentials. If the SDK cannot supply credentials, it emits a visible warning to stderr and returns false, causing the live test to skip outside CI. `tests/live_bedrock.rs#fn[report]` writes to stderr, so the warning is visible under ordinary `cargo test` output.
- `tests/live_bedrock.rs#fn[live_test_prerequisites_are_checked_without_inference]` verifies the deterministic prerequisite behavior: CI skip, malformed configuration failure, missing-configuration failure, invalid explicit selection failure, and missing-credential skip, all without invoking the model.
